title: NullPointerException during build in StateImpl.getSourceElementEntries
description: Incremental builder throws NullPointerException in StateImpl.getSourceElementEntries when parsing source entries of deleted or renamed resources during workspace build.
resolution_summary: Added guard condition `if (element == null) continue;` in StateImpl before querying element dictionary.
fix_patch_summary: Added guard condition `if (element == null) continue;` in StateImpl before querying element dictionary.

title: Deadlock on startup processing breakpoints
description: Eclipse UI deadlocks during workbench startup when the breakpoint manager thread attempts to acquire workspace lock while UI thread holds workspace lock waiting on breakpoint initialization.
resolution_summary: Deferred breakpoint notification dispatch until workspace startup finishes, breaking circular lock dependency.
fix_patch_summary: Deferred breakpoint notification dispatch until workspace startup finishes, breaking circular lock dependency.

title: Sockets don't timeout if server isn't responding
description: CVS and team repository connection sockets remain open indefinitely without timeout when remote server stops responding during network transmission, hanging workspace operations.
resolution_summary: Configured socket.setSoTimeout() with user-defined timeout preference and handled InterruptedIOException gracefully.
fix_patch_summary: Configured socket.setSoTimeout() with user-defined timeout preference and handled InterruptedIOException gracefully.

title: Could not restart the workspace after an OutOfMemoryError
description: When workspace runs out of memory during metadata indexing, corrupted lock files and uncommitted tree states prevent restarting the Eclipse IDE, causing permanent startup crashes.
resolution_summary: Added recovery routine to detect incomplete tree snapshots on startup and roll back safely to previous clean state.
fix_patch_summary: Added recovery routine to detect incomplete tree snapshots on startup and roll back safely to previous clean state.

title: CVS Authentication error: says name/password wrong when really path wrong
description: When connecting to remote repository with invalid server repository path, authentication handler misidentifies the 401/unauthorized error as invalid credentials rather than bad path.
resolution_summary: Differentiated server response status codes between credentials failure (bad password) and missing repository directory.
fix_patch_summary: Differentiated server response status codes between credentials failure (bad password) and missing repository directory.
